about_the_game:
Night Shift at the Gym

When Work Becomes Nightmare

It's 11 PM. The gym is closed, empty, silent. You're the new night janitor, alone with rows of motionless equipment and the echo of your footsteps on polished floors. What should be a simple cleaning routine slowly transforms into something far more sinister.

The Descent Begins

Armed with nothing but a mop and determination to keep your new job, you begin your shift in the fluorescent-lit emptiness. But gyms at night are different places—spaces where the familiar becomes foreign, where exercise equipment takes on ominous shapes in the shadows, and where you begin to understand that you are not truly alone.

Gameplay Duration: Approximately 15-20 minutes - A concentrated burst of workplace horror

Game Features

• Mundane Terror - Experience how the most ordinary tasks—mopping floors, wiping down machines—can become exercises in dread when performed in complete isolation.

• Escalating Unease - Each cleaning task completed brings you deeper into the gym's nocturnal reality, where something watches from the weight room and waits for the perfect moment to reveal itself.

• The Final Encounter - Your shift ends with a confrontation that transforms the familiar act of exercise into pure nightmare fuel.

The Psychology of Empty Spaces

There are no zombies here. No demons. Only you, the echo of your cleaning cart wheels, and the growing certainty that gyms were never meant to be experienced alone. Every wiped surface reflects something that shouldn't be there. Every cleaned mirror shows more than your own reflection.

"The night shift ends when you meet what's been working out in the darkness."

Experience the terror of isolation, the horror of routine work, and the nightmare that lurks where people push their physical limits—even after closing time.
